key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued Tsunami Alert Level 3 (immediate evacuation) for coastal areas including Eastern Samar and Leyte shortly after the earthquake.
Many coastal communities evacuated; surveyed barangays reported an estimated average of about 80% of residents evacuated, with only one barangay not following the advice.
No significant tsunami wave appeared and no damages were observed.
Shaking was felt at intensities up to V–VII in Pacific coastal areas of the central-southern Philippines.
Communication disruptions occurred, including major power cuts, mobile network issues in some barangays, and an instance of incorrect radio information, delaying or distorting warning messages.
missing_information: Exact list of evacuating barangays/municipalities not enumerated.
